# `app.graycard.meter.reading`

A light-meter reading containing an observed photometric quantity, observation geometry, instrument, and optional exposure solution. It supports phone meters, handheld ambient or spot meters, and imported flash-meter readings. geometry, lightKind, and createdAt are required; other fields may be added afterward. ev100, illuminance, and luminance store measurements, while exposure stores the displayed solution and its compensation, filters, and reciprocity adjustment.

- **Source:** `lexicons/app/graycard/meter/reading.json`
- **Lexicon version:** `1`
- **Definitions:** 1

## `main`

A light-meter reading containing an observed photometric quantity, observation geometry, instrument, and optional exposure solution. It supports phone meters, handheld ambient or spot meters, and imported flash-meter readings. geometry, lightKind, and createdAt are required; other fields may be added afterward. ev100, illuminance, and luminance store measurements, while exposure stores the displayed solution and its compensation, filters, and reciprocity adjustment.
